supersedes_for_future_execution: v2.0 dual-endpoint protocol; v2 files and archives remain immutable historical records
amendment_reason: Replace the system-specific LLR primary and zero-shot FoldX co-primary with one system-agnostic, label-blinded ESM-2 residue-difference primary; raise the main-panel gate to a new K=3 panel with n>=8; add support, collision, resolution, pooling, and nested-selection diagnostics.

primary_endpoint.multi_site_aggregation: sum embedding-delta vectors at every substituted residue

model.seed_average: arithmetic mean followed by simplex normalization

primary_endpoint.comparator: LOO outer-training arithmetic mean population on identical folds
primary_endpoint.fold_metric: mean absolute error across the three states

success_gate.catastrophic_fold: none with primary MAE > 2 * training-mean MAE
success_gate.drop_one_sensitivity: mean paired improvement remains >0 after deleting each mutation in turn

secondary_endpoints: state-specific FoldX zero-shot physical control when frozen state structures are available
LLR-only when a pre-reveal system-agnostic LLR package is available
CLR-Ridge on fixed outer-fold PCA features
CLR-GP on fixed outer-fold PCA features
fully nested selector among frozen fast secondary candidates
diagnostic_endpoints: nearest-neighbor support distance versus held-out primary MAE: Spearman direction and exhaustive exact label permutation for n<=9; deterministic 100000-permutation sensitivity for larger n, never a success gate
exact feature collisions, target conflicts, conflict-member error enrichment, and label-permutation status
coarse and fine K=3 ILR contrast MAE
full K=3 versus separately trained pooled K=2 shared-contrast MAE
fixed primary versus fully nested selector gap
single-mutant-only sensitivity when multi-site mutants are present

eligibility.main: entirely new system; K=3; n>=8 evaluable mutants; one construct, ligand, temperature, buffer, and state model; quantitative WT and mutant populations; state mapping frozen before execution
eligibility.supporting_only: K=3 n=5-7 or any K=2 panel
eligibility.multi_site_mutants: allowed under frozen sum aggregation; single-mutant-only sensitivity mandatory

modeler_visible_before_reveal: mutation IDs and explicit sequence indices
post_reveal_prohibitions: replacement of a failed primary prediction
